title: Evaluation of a flattened CNF
statement: Let $G$ be a list of CNF formulas over natural-number variables, and let $a$ assign a Boolean value to each natural number. The flattened formula evaluates to true under $a$ if and only if every formula in $G$ evaluates to true under $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of CNF formulas over natural-number variables
A Boolean assignment on natural numbers
replaced: For every list of clause groups and every assignment, the evaluation of the flattened CNF formula is true exactly when every group in the list evaluates to true.
